name: Newsroom to Teleprompter
tagline: Staffs a four-desk newsroom for your beat and hands back teleprompter-ready scripts.
description: You choose the beats and the voice, and it fills the rest: two researchers on the reading, an editor on the draft, and a fact-checker between the copy and publication, with a shared room tying the desks. It comes back built for the camera: a script paced for a teleprompter, plus the social posts to run with it.
author: TechDadsLife
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
